A '''Net Accelerator''' was a component used in [[Net gun/Legends|net guns]] such as [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms']] [[RL-40 stun net launcher]]. The accelerator was located in the weapon's [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], and assisting in the launching of the [[Stun net/Legends|stun net]] towards a target.<ref name="EGWT" />
